title: Corn Knight in Stasis
description: A towering anthropomorphic corn cob knight in blue armor stands in a stormy greenhouse filled with giant red-capped mushrooms and glowing corn stalks. A swirling white vortex with a black cat silhouette spins in the foreground while a small silhouetted figure stands before a glowing blue portal in the background.
prompt: A towering anthropomorphic corn cob warrior wearing intricate blue armor with a sign reading STASIS & VELLUM stands inside a dark stormy greenhouse. Giant red and green mushrooms, hanging corn stalks, and glowing blue portal in the background with a silhouetted child. A swirling white vortex containing a black cat silhouette spins in the foreground. Rain falls from the glass roof. Moody surreal fantasy style, dark atmosphere, detailed digital painting.
